nodes.name: mcp-health-check-fixed.js
nodes.summary: Fixed MCP health-check hook for Claude Code that probes command and HTTP-based MCP servers before tool use, manages a persistent health/quarantine state file, and auto-reconnects unhealthy servers. Resolves the Windows .cmd shim resolution bug present in the upstream version.
nodes.languageNotes: Self-contained zero-dependency Node.js script using only built-in modules (fs, os, path, http, https, child_process). Designed to be run as a Claude Code PreToolUse/PostToolUse hook binary with JSON I/O over stdin/stdout.

nodes.name: handlePreToolUse
nodes.summary: Core PreToolUse hook handler that checks MCP server health state, optionally blocks tool calls to quarantined servers, attempts reconnection, and updates the persistent state file with health/failure results.

nodes.name: handlePostToolUseFailure
nodes.summary: PostToolUse hook handler for tool call failures that detects failure codes, marks servers as unhealthy, attempts reconnection, and re-probes to see if the server recovered.

nodes.name: probeCommandServer
nodes.summary: Probes a stdio/command-based MCP server by spawning the process, waiting for a startup signal or timeout, and returning a health result with stderr capture.

nodes.name: probeServer
nodes.summary: Dispatches to HTTP or command-based server probe depending on resolved server config type, returning a unified probe result.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Entry point that reads stdin JSON, extracts the MCP target server name, dispatches to PreToolUse or PostToolUse handler based on hook type, and writes the block/pass decision to stdout.

nodes.name: WINDOWS-QUIRKS.md
nodes.summary: Platform-specific documentation covering Windows 10/11 quirks for hive-mind-cli, including the .cmd shim resolution bug, quarantine state clearing after first install, and a 10-second health verification procedure.

nodes.name: NOTICE
nodes.summary: Legal notice file for the hive-mind-cli package listing copyright attribution and third-party dependency acknowledgements.

nodes.name: postinstall.cjs
nodes.summary: Post-install script that detects whether the installed Claude Code MCP health-check hook contains the Windows .cmd shim bug and automatically patches it by copying the fixed version from the package assets.
nodes.languageNotes: CommonJS module (.cjs) so it runs without ESM flag requirement in all Node.js versions during npm postinstall lifecycle.

nodes.name: detectAndPatch
nodes.summary: Main detection logic that checks if the upstream mcp-health-check.js contains the Windows bug and conditionally copies the fixed version, with backup support.

nodes.name: dropOverride
nodes.summary: Safely copies the fixed mcp-health-check.js to the target path, backing up the existing file with a timestamp suffix before overwriting.

nodes.languageNotes: 192 named exports covering the full memory substrate — the canonical integration point for any consumer of @waggle/hive-mind-core.

nodes.name: parse-date-window.ts
nodes.summary: Parses natural-language date range queries (e.g., 'in 2024', 'last 3 months', 'Q2 2025') into UTC ISO date window bounds used by the memory search subsystem to filter results temporally.

nodes.name: parseDateWindow
nodes.summary: Exported function that matches a query string against date patterns (year, quarter, month, ISO range) and returns a {lo, hi} UTC ISO string pair representing the matching date window.

nodes.name: recall-context.ts
nodes.summary: Provides temporal formatting helpers for the memory recall assembler: date prefix generation, dated snippet rendering, reference date computation, and the TEMPORAL_GUIDANCE constant injected into LLM prompts to anchor relative date reasoning.

nodes.name: resolve-relative-date.ts
nodes.summary: Resolves natural-language relative date expressions (e.g., 'yesterday', 'last month', 'last Tuesday', '3 months ago') to ISO date strings relative to a given anchor date, used when constructing date window queries from user queries.

nodes.name: resolveRelativeDate
nodes.summary: Exported function that pattern-matches a natural-language date string and resolves it to an ISO date string using arithmetic helpers (addDays, addMonths, addYears, lastWeekday).

nodes.name: workspace-manager.ts
nodes.summary: Implements the WorkspaceManager class providing filesystem-backed CRUD operations for hive-mind workspaces: create, list, get, update, delete, group management, team workspace detection, default workspace tracking, and ID generation with collision avoidance.

nodes.name: WorkspaceManager
nodes.summary: Filesystem-backed workspace lifecycle manager with 20 methods covering full CRUD, group queries, team workspace detection, default tracking, and safe ID generation.
